newsitem.title: USA: Treasury's Rubin welcomes Japan reform proposals.
newsitem.headline: Treasury's Rubin welcomes Japan reform proposals.

text.p: Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin on Tuesday welcomed financial reform proposals outlined to him in a telephone conversation by Japanese Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka.

"We look forward to learning more about the concrete proposals envisioned by the Japanese Government to further develop and open the Japanese financial market," Rubin said in a prepared statement issued by Treasury.
Rubin spoke to Mitsuzuka by telephone on Tuesday morning and offered close cooperation on issues of mutual interest, the statement said.
"The United States has supported for some time the broad objectives of deregulation and transparency in Japan's financial market," Rubin said.
Rubin congratulated Mitsuzuka on his appointment as finance secretary in the new minority government formed by Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto last week, the statement said.
